zh: 修复首页「工作台」的用量面板停在打开窗口那一刻的数字：面板挂载期间按固定周期重取，回到窗口时也重取；宿主侧的汇总缓存从 5 分钟降到 30 秒，等汇总结果的轮询上限放宽，大历史不再先看到旧值。
en: Fix the Studio home's usage panel standing on the figures of the moment the window opened: the panel reads the roll-up again on a fixed period while it stands on the page and once more when the reader comes back to the window, the host half's roll-up cache drops from five minutes to thirty seconds, and waiting for a cold fold no longer gives up before the numbers land.
